name: Ryū Kyōdai
source:
Ryū is a rival in Heartbreaker: The Visual Novel, and the antagonist of Episode 12.
As the final rival, Ryū will be the most difficult to eliminate.

After being put through veritable Hell the past year, Kouhai takes some convincing to become a prospect of the Prefects. Ryū has always strived to make her family proud and to bring national prestige to Kareji, and believes she can do that with a hard-working pupil like Kouhai under her wing.
